text:
Noor Abdi: Hi all :wave: I'm Noor, joining Platform on the infra team (UTC+3). Laptop arrives tomorrow. Two quick setup q's: who owns access to the model registry + dev cluster? And is there a preferred shell/config (zsh, bash, or any dotfiles repo to clone)? Also, is someone assigned as my buddy?

IT Support: Welcome Noor! :tada: For cluster access, open a ticket here https://redwood.it/it-ticket and tag 'infra-access'. Model registry perms are handled by the DataInfra group; @Priya Rao can add you once we have your employee ID. For shell, we don't enforce one but most infra folks use zsh + oh-my-zsh. If you want, we can copy a starter dotfiles repo into your home.

Sam Wells: Hey Noor — I'm your buddy for the first six weeks. Happy to pair on first PRs and the cluster tour. We'll schedule a 45m pairing sess on day 2. For cluster creds, we use the company keyupload workflow (not personal keys). After MDM you should generate an ed25519 key and upload via the portal.

OnboardingBot: Welcome to Redwood, Noor Abdi! The MDM invite was sent to noor.abdi@example.com. Please enroll your device and confirm here when done. Meanwhile we auto-created a profile in the new-hire doc for you.

Noor Abdi: Thanks — I got the MDM invite and started enrollment. How do I upload the SSH key to the portal? Any required key comment format?

Jules Kim: Upload the public key at https://id.redwood/internal-keys after generating it. We prefer ed25519 with a comment like: "noor@redwood". Example commands:

```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "noor@redwood"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub | pbcopy   # macOS
```

Then paste into the portal. If you see permission denied when connecting to the dev cluster run `ssh -v` and paste the log in the ticket.

Priya Rao: I can add you to the model-registry team once you confirm your employee ID. Also FYI we have a weekly model-sync meeting Thursdays 9:30am UTC — feel free to drop in.

Noor Abdi: Employee ID is E-43921. Enrollment finished, MDM installed. Thanks everyone! Small fun thing: I make very loud playlists while debugging, apologies in advance :headphones:. Looking forward to the pairing session, Sam.

Sam Wells: Loud playlists encouraged :metal: Welcome aboard, Noor — see you at the intro roundtable tomorrow at 14:00 UTC.
